summary: ZyVersa Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the resignation of independent director Dr. Min Chul Park (personal reasons, no disagreement). Separately, the company disclosed a strategic review exploring cost-cutting measures, divestiture of its VAR 200 or IC-100 product candidates, headcount reduction, and a possible 'going dark' suspension of SEC reporting under Rule 12h-3. The board is also considering a sale of the company or assets, restructuring, or reorganization to maximize shareholder value. Executives voluntarily reduced compensation to conserve cash. No definitive terms were provided; watch for capital-raising updates or asset sale developments.
